title: Interaction coefficients have their own consistency equation
question: When direct and indirect paths carry opposing treatment-by-covariate interactions, does the pooled network meta-regression mask the modifier while the effect-consistency check passes, and can an interaction-consistency check detect it?
design: Triangle networks with path-specific interaction slopes (consistent, partly opposing, cancelling), two to eight studies per comparison, two covariate spreads and effect inconsistency absent or present; consistency meta-regression, modifier selection, interaction and effect consistency checks. 36 cells, 2000 replicates each.
